educational_rationale.topic: Vulnerability Scanning vs Malicious Reconnaissance (False Positive Discipline)
educational_rationale.certification_relevance: Security+ SY0-701 (Section 3.1 Vulnerability Management & Section 2.1 Threat Actors vs Legitimate Assessments) & Network+ (Section 4.2 Network Policies & Asset Categorization)
educational_rationale.deep_dive: A mature SOC analyst does not treat every port scan as an adversary. True vulnerability scanners (Tenable Nessus, Rapid7 InsightVM, Qualys) operate from designated management subnets and transmit explicit identification headers (e.g. 'Nessus-SOAP-Audit' with change ticket references). Checking the corporate CMDB (Configuration Management Database) and Change Management tickets is step 1 before reacting to internal scanning alerts.
